annotation.interpretation_a: Implementations can choose to send only one frame per QUIC packet, even if the packet has sufficient capacity for more.
annotation.interpretation_b: Implementations can send multiple frames per QUIC packet, up to the packet's capacity.
annotation.justification: The use of 'MAY' allows for implementations to either send a single frame or multiple frames. Without a maximum limit, implementations could potentially create very large packets, or very small packets. This constitutes an incomplete constraint.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify any limit on the number of frames that MAY be sent. A missing constraint on the maximum number of frames could affect implementation.
